violations.text: Establishment's Rhode Island Manager Certified In Food Safety license is expired. Other staff has active food safety certificate. FMC to re-instate license. Application provided during time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 12/18/2026

The hand-washing sink at the bar wash blocked by drink mats and rags. Water pressure was also observed low. Cold water handle was unable to be turned during time of inspection. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Items were removed and PIC informed of maintenance needed for dispensing water at bar handsink. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2026

Molluscan shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. PIC informed and HANDLING FRESH AND FROZEN RAW MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH guidance document provided during time of inspection. https://datahealth.ri.gov/materialbyothers/guidelines/MolluscanShellfishHandling.pdf Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2026

The door to the outside, located near dining office, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 12/02/2026

Dishmachine at bar was not dispensing the proper chemical concentration. Club is not opened at this time. Equipment to be properly adjusted. Establishment will be using 3 bay sink at bar when bar opens on scheduled occasions for the remainder of the season. QT in kitchen dispenser: 300 PPM. New Violation. Correct By: 12/02/2026

2 door reach-in cooler handles were observed held together by duct tape. Equipment components such as doors, seals, hinges, fasteners, and kick plates shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted in accordance with manufacturer's specifications. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 12/18/2026

Staff were observed not wearing hair restraints. Food employees must wear hair restraints such as hats, hair coverings, or nets that are worn to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment/utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 06/05/2025
Water pressure at handwashing sink at bar was inadequate. Adequate pressure required for proper sanitation. New Violation. Correct By: 06/19/2025
